description: This file defines the Session class within the Opencart admin startup controllers. Its main purpose is to initialize and manage user sessions, including starting sessions, managing session cookies, and ensuring session security.

classes.name: Session
classes.description: A controller class responsible for initializing user sessions, setting session cookies with appropriate security options, and managing session lifecycle within the admin startup process.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initializes the session, retrieves or generates a session ID, starts the session, and sets the session cookie with security parameters.
